note: Verification sign-offs for the lineage graph. Each entry is a recorded human statement: who checked a node or relation, when, and on what basis, pinned to the register SHA-256 hashes at that time. Edit this file by hand (index.html drafts entries to paste in), then rebuild with scripts/build_lineage_graph.py. The generator marks an entry stale when the current hashes differ from the recorded ones. Nothing here is generated automatically. Entry shape: {"id": "<node id or source->target edge id>", "by": "name", "on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "basis": "what was checked", "hashes": {"node": "<sha256>"} for a node or {"source": "<sha256>", "target": "<sha256>"} for an edge}.
